dedupe_keys.name: gridded global datasets for gdp and human development index 1990 2015 kummu et al dryad

description: This dataset by Matti Kummu, Maija Taka and Joseph Guillaume gives gap-filled annual grids of gross domestic product and the Human Development Index for the whole world. The DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-28 describe three annual products for 1990 to 2015 at 5 arc-minute resolution: GDP per capita at purchasing power parity, total GDP at purchasing power parity and HDI, plus total GDP at 30 arc-seconds for 1990, 2000 and 2015 and the administrative units used. Sub-national statistics were used only to distribute the reported national value, so the grids stay consistent with official national totals. Coverage is global for 1990 to 2015. The files are free under CC0 1.0 on Dryad and total about 800 MB; the file formats were not read. Caveats: the series stops in 2015, values inside an administrative unit are spread, not observed, and the grids describe economic activity, not physical assets. It supports hazard exposure and resilience studies, such as estimating the economic output exposed to a flood or cyclone footprint, or weighting infrastructure disruption by the GDP of the areas served. Related record: the global gridded GDP dataset consistent with the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways.
